timestep_s.note: Numerical configuration, not a measured physical property.

gravity_mps2.note: Numerical configuration, not a measured physical property.

lower_mass_kg.note: Whole lower assembly lumped at arm midpoint; not inferred from mesh volume.

upper_mass_kg.note: Upper beam and fork lumped at centerline midpoint.

head_carriage_mass_kg.note: Stationary portion of assumed head guide assembly.

head_float_mass_kg.note: Collector, carbon strips, carriers and assumed floating pins/yokes.

lower_inertia_scale.note: Scales all principal moments of analytic lower-arm inertia, independently of mass.

upper_inertia_scale.note: Scales all principal moments of analytic upper-arm inertia, independently of mass.

head_carriage_inertia_scale.note: Scales analytic head carriage moments independently of mass.

head_float_inertia_scale.note: Scales analytic collector moments independently of mass.

lower_stiffness_Nm_per_rad.note: Passive joint spring about source reference pose; not a measured real return spring.

upper_stiffness_Nm_per_rad.note: Passive joint spring, not an inter-stage transmission or closure.

head_pitch_stiffness_Nm_per_rad.note: Relative pitch compliance at U->H endpoint, no world-leveling law.

head_slide_stiffness_N_per_m.note: Assumed vertical guide spring, no measured spring internals.

joint_armature_kg_m2.note: Numerical configuration, not a measured physical property.

head_slide_armature_kg.note: Numerical configuration, not a measured physical property.

contact_friction.note: Solver friction coefficient; carbon/copper materials are not calibrated.

contact_timeconst_s.note: MuJoCo positive solref time constant; not directly a measured material stiffness.

contact_impedance_min.note: Numerical configuration, not a measured physical property.

contact_impedance_max.note: Numerical configuration, not a measured physical property.

contact_impedance_width_m.note: Numerical configuration, not a measured physical property.

wire_radius_m.note: CAD design diameter 5 mm, not a physical measurement.

torque_limit_Nm.note: Safety envelope for direct numerical joint torque experiments.

head_load_limit_N.note: Safety envelope for external laboratory-equivalent head load.

unmodeled: Physical E-axis motion relative to lower arm; E->U carrier is provisionally rigid with lower arm.
Both slender adjustable rods: 3D ball centers, hinge attachment ownership and mechanical closure.
Air bellows effective area, pressure chamber, hysteresis, force path, air circuit and deformation.
B32 black barrel linkage, bore, stroke, piston side, seals, friction and function.
Rigid head linkage leveling/synchronization; no ideal parallelogram or algebraic fold relation is imposed.
Actual head guide internals and which guide pieces translate; present split is a declared equivalent.
Wire tension, sag, transverse dynamics, droppers and speed-dependent catenary effects; wire is fixed here.
Carbon wear, elasticity, arcing, electric current and copper braid flexibility.
Physical masses, inertia tensors, damping, springs and true motion stops; all dynamics are uncalibrated.
Arm-roof, link-link and cover collisions; only collector/wire and numerical joint stops are solved.
inertia_model: Analytic slender-beam / box tensors from declared masses and equivalent envelopes. Independent positive inertia scales are configurable; tensors are not mesh-derived measurements.
